tickets.title: Worker entry and instructions stop pulling orchestrator docs
tickets.what: docs/llm/imp-load-2026-11-22.md ranks 1, 4, 6 (instruction part), 7; D-2026-11-22-17. Archive the 2026-11-03 root AGENTS.md to docs/archive/root/ and write a ~25-line worker-safe AGENTS.md (read the brief and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §8; do not read STATE, delegation, spec in full or archived docs unless the brief names them). Trim CLAUDE.md so the orchestrator read list is marked orchestrator-only. In packages/hud-mcp/instructions/{implementer,general,frontend-implementer}.md and integrations/pi/roles/implementer.md: drop the CodeGraph paragraphs (search with grep and read); git self-checks are `git status -s`, `git diff --stat`, `git diff --check` (no full diff dumps); batch independent reads in one turn and read large files by range; targeted tests while iterating, one full `npm test` at the end, repeat it only when a fix touched shared code; never poll with sleep loops. Keep the release-archive exclusion of .codegraph as is.

acceptance.text: A fresh pi imp in a worktree gets no instruction that sends it to STATE.md, delegation.md or docs/archive

tickets.title: pi workers skip the MCP adapter when no server is configured; short briefs inline
tickets.what: Ranks 3 and 6 (launcher part). In the pi dispatch path (src/mcp/thin-main.ts dispatchPi and the pi-role launch args), when the job does not set `mcp` and pi's MCP config lists no servers, start without the MCP adapter. When the brief is under 16 KB, put its text in the first user message so turn 1 is not a read of brief.md (the brief file stays on disk). Spec §2.1.4 switches line unchanged unless the default changes visibly; if it does, one sentence, told to the owner.

acceptance.text: With an empty pi MCP config a pi worker launches without the adapter; `mcp: true` still enables it
A short brief arrives inline and the worker does not read brief.md first

tickets.title: Child sonic results reach imp as a push; no zero-timeout polling
tickets.what: Rank 5. When a sonic started by a worker via hud_sonic settles, deliver a ready notice into the parent pi session (same mechanism as the orchestrator answer message) and drop the `0 checks once` hint from hud_sonic's schema so workers wait or keep working instead of polling with timeout_s 0. Tell imp in its instructions to give sonic non-overlapping reads.

acceptance.text: A worker that starts sonic and keeps editing receives the result without calling hud_sonic with timeout_s 0

tickets.title: Sonic works in few batched turns and cannot call hud_sonic
tickets.what: docs/llm/workers-load-2026-11-22.md §3.1, D-2026-11-22-18. Omit hud_sonic from the worker tools of a sonic job (packages/hud-mcp/bin/worker-tools.mjs and the pi extension). packages/hud-mcp/instructions/sonic.md: batch read-only inspection (parallel reads or one compound shell command per turn, not many tiny sed/ls turns), soft budget of about 20 turns (then report facts gathered plus unchecked paths), report at most 60 lines. implementer.md (and reviewer/oracle where they use sonic): give sonic named files, symbols and questions, split broad surveys into narrow parallel sonics.

acceptance.text: A sonic job's tool list has no hud_sonic
Shipped sonic and caller instructions carry the batching, budget and narrow-brief rules

tickets.title: Reviewer keeps its context under 150k
tickets.what: Workers study §3.2, D-2026-11-22-18. reviewer.md: start from the brief's diff --stat and design intent, read diffs file by file (never one multi-commit diff), hand caller/test/spec lookups to parallel narrow sonics, re-read nothing already read. Reviewer default stays gpt-6.2-sol max.

acceptance.text: Shipped reviewer instructions carry the file-by-file and sonic-lookup rules

tickets.title: CLI workers load only the HUD MCP and get instructions as system prompt
tickets.what: Workers study §3.4 and §4 rank 3, D-2026-11-22-18. dispatchCli: Claude CLI workers start with --strict-mcp-config and only the HUD worker MCP plus servers the role file names (new optional role field, e.g. mcp_servers); Codex workers likewise only the HUD MCP plus named ones; agy as far as its CLI allows (say what it cannot). Pass role instructions as system prompt where the CLI supports it (claude --append-system-prompt) and inline briefs under 16 KB in the first message instead of 'Read <instructions> and then <brief>'. Reuses ticket 02's inline-brief helper. Spec §2.1.4 gets one sentence on worker MCP scope, told to the owner.

acceptance.text: A Claude CLI worker launched by HUD sees only the HUD MCP unless the role names more
A short brief reaches a CLI worker inline; no startup read turns
